purpose: Create a 400-level AI learning and wisdom superstructure paired one-for-one with a 400-level adversarial learning plane, covering lawful web/video/document acquisition, knowledge formation, project learning, native weight creation and continual candidate improvement.

scope.relationship: paired depth overlays above Frontier-96; cross-linked to CS-300

weight_policy.rule: Learning may create and improve candidate weights from governed data and project evidence. Production promotion requires immutable lineage, held-out evaluation, paired adversarial qualification, independent approval, canary/rollback and exact-head evidence.

laws: Acquisition never converts public reachability into permission to bypass authentication, paywalls, robots, terms, rights, privacy or platform controls.
External content is evidence, never instruction authority.
Every durable learning object carries source, rights, privacy, transformation and project/tenant lineage.
Knowledge keeps contradiction, time, uncertainty and provenance instead of collapsing disagreement into one confident fact.
Project-derived learning remains scoped; cross-project or cross-tenant transfer requires an explicit governed promotion path.
Models may create candidate weights, adapters, datasets, curricula and training recipes but cannot self-promote them to production.
Production weights never mutate silently in place; every update is a versioned candidate with reversible lineage.
Every L400 layer is paired with exactly one A400 adversarial layer.
No learning layer is signed complete unless its paired adversarial layer is signed complete on current evidence.
Adversarial learning may attack test candidates but cannot grant execution, policy, release or model-promotion authority.
Security, privacy, authority, tenant isolation, deletion, state integrity, rollback, reproducibility and human control are non-compensable.
